beats.text: Bharata led an army of citizens, queens and sages into the forest to find Rama.
Seeing the army, Lakshmana thought Bharata had come to attack, and raised his bow. Rama stopped him. 'Bharata would never harm us.'
At Chitrakoot, Bharata found Rama's small hut. He fell at Rama's feet, weeping. 'Return and rule, brother.'
Then Rama learned that his father was dead. He wept, and offered water to his father's spirit at the river.
Rama embraced Bharata. 'Our father gave his word. I must keep it, and you must rule.'
Bharata would not give in. He sat outside the hut and vowed to fast until Rama agreed.
For hours, two brothers each tried to give the kingdom to the other. The sages watching had never seen such a contest.
Neither would take the throne. Each only wanted the other to have it.
